title: DataCore Domain
description: A top-level data domain - the highest level of taxonomy in the DataCore catalog. Domains group related products (e.g., the 'financial' domain contains the VN Equity product).

id.description: Stable machine identifier for the domain. Must be one of the canonical DataCore domains.

description.description: A short paragraph explaining what kinds of data live in this domain.

icon.description: Optional URL to an icon image for UI display.

tags.description: Freeform tags for search and filtering.
